Alpha-Pharma Healthcare
manufactures a wide range of pharmaceutical products, focusing heavily on
hormone replacement therapies, men's health, oncology, and general therapeutics
. Because multiple distinct companies share the name Alpha Pharma or Alpha Pharmaceuticals globally (including major lines in India and regional distributors), product lines vary by the specific corporate entity.

Alpha Pharm (operating as
Alpha Pharm Group
in South Africa) functions primarily as a full-line independent pharmaceutical wholesaler and franchise network rather than a single-product manufacturer
. It distributes over 13,000 to 15,000 medical, surgical, natural, and FMCG products
through six regional distribution centers, dedicating roughly 90% of its inventory to established manufacturer brands and keeping its own-brand range under 10%.
LinkedIn
DáNiel Nel
Core Business Model
Wholesale & Distribution:
Operates major distribution hubs across South Africa (including Silverton, Bloemfontein, Durban, East London, Gqeberha, and Cape Town).
Franchise Network:
Supports independent community pharmacies and
Alpha Clin
primary healthcare facilities.
Partner Brands & Associated Products
Rather than relying on exclusive single-partner manufacturing, Alpha Pharm distributes a vast comprehensive array of prominent pharmaceutical and OTC partner brands available via participating community pharmacies:
Alpha52
OTC & Family Care:
Calpol, Gaviscon, Dettol, Vicks, Strepsils, and Iliadin.
Pain & Relief:
Nurofen, Disprin, and Painblok.
